Three towns Ryeton, Tonbridge and Uphampton are represented on the diagram by the points labelled R, T and U, respectively.
The distance from Tonbridge to Ryeton is the same as the distance from Tonbridge to Uphampton.
Uphampton is south of Tonbridge.
Ryeton is on a bearing of $210^{\circ}$ from Tonbridge.
What is the bearing of Uphampton from Ryeton?
